turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm deep in the weeds with the Groundskeeper project right now. The batch processing module is a nightmare.
That sounds frustrating. What specifically is causing the issue with the batch processing?
It's the state management. I used to think I had to delete and re-insert records to keep the audit trail clean, but that was killing performance. I've finally figured out the right approach.
Oh? What's the new approach you've settled on?
Groundskeeper lesson learned is to update items in place by finding them by ID and updating only status/reason/processed_at fields.
That definitely makes more sense for performance and data integrity. It avoids the overhead of creating new records.
Exactly. It's a huge relief to get that sorted. Anyway, on a completely different note, did you hear if the coffee maker arrived today?
I don't have real-time tracking for deliveries, but you might want to check your email for a shipping notification.
Yeah, I'll check. Just hoping I don't have to wait another week for caffeine.
